newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAISIO RALLIES ON, HITS ANOTHER LIFE-HIGH.
newsitem.headline: RAISIO RALLIES ON, HITS ANOTHER LIFE-HIGH.

text.p: Shares in food, animal feed and chemicals group Raision Tehtaat Oy advanced to yet another life-high on Tuesday boosted by continuing overseas demand after recent positive analyst comments, brokers said.
At 1145/0945 GMT, Raisio traded at a life-high 445.00 markka, up 40.00 markka or almost 10 percent.
Volume was a lively 20 million markka.
"A lot of investors are seeking short-term profits in Raisio. They hope it would add another 10 markka," a broker said, but declined to estimate how far Raisio could advance.
CS First Boston said in a research note received on Monday it was maintaining its buy recommendation on Raisio. CSFB set a 12-month target price of 450.00 markka for Raisio.
